title: Remote desktop
signIn: Sign in through Account center first
intro: Choose a Windows PC or Mac on your account. Screen and input access begins after approval on that computer.
keyboardHint: Click the screen to control it. Press Esc to release the keyboard.
text: Type text on the remote computer
textHint: Supports Unicode. Clipboard contents are never read or synchronized.
failed: The remote connection was interrupted. Connect again.
REMOTE_CAPTURE_FAILED: Screen capture is unavailable. On Mac, allow screen recording in System Settings and retry.
REMOTE_INPUT_FAILED: Input control is unavailable. On Mac, allow Accessibility in System Settings. Windows cannot control elevated windows.
REMOTE_BUSY: One of the computers already has a remote session. End it first.
REMOTE_ENDED: The request expired or the session ended. Connect again.
REMOTE_UNSUPPORTED: Remote desktop currently supports Windows and macOS.
